notes: Pattern: roughly a third of the Key Concepts (Ch 3.4.4, 3.4.7, 3.4.8, 3.4.9, the Ahonen study, RALIC counts) were drafted from the converted source rather than the deep ref. Most of it is source-accurate, but none of it traces through the audited deep ref. Two items appear in neither (source-code escrow and related mitigation mechanisms; Axelrod). Questions that reuse an already-flagged premise (free-riders at line 65; cooperation threshold at 95, 112, 139; social loafing at 96, 136; mitigation lists at 55, 88, 97, 103, 134) are counted as faithful applied guidance, with the premise graded once at its Key Concept. Integration rows for OB (TKI five modes, French and Raven bases of power, negotiation), Letaw (interviews, focus groups, lab studies, exploratory research) and Scrum Guide check out. The worked example's figures (18 requirements, 110-hour estimate) are hypothetical and not presented as source findings.
